# lucide-morph (vendored)

Recovered from the published `@musistudio/lucide-morph@1.0.0` and
`@musistudio/lucide-morph-react@1.0.0` source maps (`sourcesContent`), both MIT
licensed. Vendored so the app no longer depends on packages published outside
this repository.

Source map coverage was complete except for `morph/types.ts`, which ships as a
type-only declaration and was reconstructed from `dist/morph/types.d.ts`.

To refresh, re-extract from the npm tarballs and re-apply the import rewrite in
`react.tsx` (`@musistudio/lucide-morph/...` -> relative paths).
